title: Basic Vow Renewal Ceremony Package
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Booking is for two people only, renewing their vows. Up to 10 guests may attend.
Minister Fee of $50 cash is not included and will be collected when you arrive.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This Basic Vow Renewal Package is designed for couples seeking a heartfelt, personalized ceremony in a modern and welcoming setting. Led by experienced photographers who specialize in capturing genuine moments, the ceremony reflects the unique journey of your marriage and ensures you’ll leave with beautiful, sentimental photos as keepsakes. Enjoy a seamless experience that’s perfect for honoring your love story, whether it’s an intimate celebration or shared with close family and friends.
